# Inert recorded Autoverse fixture

`autoverse-classic-recorded.bundle.zip` is the exact original portable evidence
export from the completed native run named in `autoverse-classic-recorded.json`.
The source candidate, bundle/journal/plan/semantic digests and source evidence are
recorded there. No snapshot, run, report, journal or archive member was rewritten.

This fixture contains 71 original Studio journal records. Source times are absent;
host receipt time is not a mapped simulator clock. Original internal integrity is
distinct from producer authentication and current reader/provider admission.

Use only the evidence import/inspection API to load it. It conveys no current run,
snapshot, process, permit, device or provider authority. The imported reader for
the original provider remains unsupported until separately admitted. A successful
import is a recorded-data check, never a positive execution result.

Synthetic reader/codec data remains separately labelled under
`tests/fixtures/evidence/`; the native executable and fake provider are separately
described in `tests/fixtures/providers/catalog.json`.
